texts.What about n8n or the role caught your a: I am an n8n user, not just an applicant. My lab operates a production fleet of six machines run by AI agents - a consensus layer, persistent memory, an AI-native CRM and 100+ automation routines - and n8n is part of that stack: real workflows run through a live n8n instance, and I have felt both the power and the sharp edges (we even added our own change-authorship convention on top of workflow node notes, because we needed to know who changed what). A Senior PM (Enterprise) role on a product I operate daily, at a company treating automation as the platform for AI agents, is the closest match between a job posting and my actual working life I have seen this year.
texts.Tell us about the personal or side proje: The project is my daily operating system: a production fleet of six machines operated by Claude agents, built almost entirely with AI coding tools - I am the non-engineer who owns problem framing, architecture decisions and evals, while agents implement. Public pieces: claw-consensus (reproducible multi-machine agent consensus with an offline demo, published evals and FAILURE-MODES.md), verbatim-citation-gate (zero-token gate + burden-of-proof judge that catches fabricated RAG citations, MIT), sqlite-graph-memory and second-brain-starter-kit - 110 public repos in total. The fleet runs my CRM, knowledge base and 100+ scheduled routines; n8n handles workflow automation inside it. Published reliability measurement: 0/17 high-risk (Tier-2) actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs.
